mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `user` ( phone, wechat_openid, qq_openid, email, username, password_hash, role, status, avatar_url, bio, gender, birthday, region, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{phone}, #{wechatOpenid}, #{qqOpenid}, #{email}, #{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{role}, #{status}, #{avatarUrl}, #{bio}, #{gender}, #{birthday}, #{region}, NOW(), NOW() )

mapper.update: UPDATE `user` SET phone = #{phone}, email = #{email}, username = #{username}, avatar_url = #{avatarUrl}, bio = #{bio}, gender = #{gender}, birthday = #{birthday}, region = #{region}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE `user` SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE `user` SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS id, u.username AS username, u.avatar_url AS avatarUrl, u.bio AS bio, u.role AS role, u.create_time AS createTime, COALESCE(pc.post_count, 0) AS postCount, COALESCE(fc.follower_count, 0) AS followerCount FROM `user` u LEFT JOIN ( SELECT p.user_id, COUNT(1) AS post_count FROM `post` p WHERE p.status = 0 GROUP BY p.user_id ) pc ON pc.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT uf.followee_id, COUNT(1) AS follower_count FROM `user_follow` uf GROUP BY uf.followee_id ) fc ON fc.followee_id = u.id WHERE u.status = 1 AND ( u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR IFNULL(u.bio, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) ORDER BY (CASE WHEN u.username = #{keyword} THEN 3 WHEN u.username LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') THEN 2 ELSE 1 END) DESC, followerCount DESC, u.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM `user` u WHERE u.status = 1 AND ( u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR IFNULL(u.bio, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

SELECT u.id AS id, u.username AS username, u.avatar_url AS avatarUrl, u.bio AS bio, u.phone AS phone, u.role AS role, u.status AS status, COALESCE(pc.post_count, 0) AS postCount, COALESCE(fc.follower_count, 0) AS followerCount, u.create_time AS createTime, u.update_time AS updateTime FROM `user` u LEFT JOIN ( SELECT p.user_id, COUNT(1) AS post_count FROM `post` p WHERE p.status = 0 GROUP BY p.user_id ) pc ON pc.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT uf.followee_id, COUNT(1) AS follower_count FROM `user_follow` uf GROUP BY uf.followee_id ) fc ON fc.followee_id = u.id WHERE u.id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM `user` WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT id, update_time FROM `user` WHERE update_time >= #{since} ORDER BY update_time ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT u.id AS id, u.username AS username, u.avatar_url AS avatarUrl, u.gender AS gender, u.phone AS phone, u.email AS email, u.role AS role, u.status AS status, u.region AS region, u.create_time AS createTime, COALESCE(pc.post_count, 0) AS postCount, COALESCE(vc.voucher_count, 0) AS voucherCount FROM `user` u LEFT JOIN ( SELECT p.user_id, COUNT(1) AS post_count FROM `post` p WHERE p.status = 0 GROUP BY p.user_id ) pc ON pc.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT m.user_id, COUNT(1) AS voucher_count FROM `merchant` m INNER JOIN `voucher` v ON v.merchant_id = m.id GROUP BY m.user_id ) vc ON vc.user_id = u.id
ORDER BY u.create_time DESC, u.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM `user` u
SELECT id FROM `user` WHERE role = #{role} AND status = 1 ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM `user`
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM `user` WHERE role = 0 AND (is_student_verified = 1 OR status = 1)
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM `user` WHERE role = 1 AND (is_merchant = 1 OR status = 1)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT region) FROM `user` WHERE region IS NOT NULL AND region != ''
SELECT COALESCE(gender, 0) AS name, COUNT(1) AS value FROM `user` GROUP BY COALESCE(gender, 0)
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(region, ''), '未知地区') AS name, COUNT(1) AS value FROM `user` GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(region, ''), '未知地区') ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(occupation, ''), '未填写') AS name, COUNT(1) AS value FROM `user` GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(occupation, ''), '未填写') ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT #{limit}
